fields.name: ArgentSeaClusteringProviderBuilder host-builder configuration family
fields.contract:
ArgentSeaClusteringProviderBuilder is a final provider-builder surface for both Orleans host roles, registered for configuration-driven hosts as provider type "ArgentSeaSql" of category "Clustering" on both the Silo and the Client side.

For either a silo host or a client host, Configure accepts that host builder, a provider name, and a configuration section. The operation binds ClusterOptions from the supplied configuration section and enables ArgentSea clustering on the same host builder. The two host-role overloads provide the same clustering-setup outcome.
